title: Retrospective Analysis of serumlevels of antiinfective agents
summary: By retrospective analysis of serumlevels of antiinfective agents and laboratory parameters in electronic medical records we would like to evaluate factors influencing the quality of antiinfective therapy

interventions.name: Retrospective Analysis of the Quality of antiinfective therapy by searching for (laboratory) parameters influencing velocity of achieving and stability of therapeutic drug Levels.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Antiinfective therapy monitored by therapeutic drug Monitoring;
duration of therapy >3 days
Exclusion criteria:
None
